exam_scheme.note: ISRO conducts recruitment for Technical Assistant and Scientific Assistant positions through a two-stage examination process across its centres (URSC, VSSC, SDSC SHAR, LPSC, SAC, NRSC, IPRU). Stage 1 is a Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 80 multiple-choice questions of diploma/degree curriculum standard, duration 90 minutes. Marking: 1 mark for each correct answer, with negative marking of 0.33 marks for each incorrect answer. Stage 2 is a practical, curriculum-based Skill Test. The Skill Test is purely qualifying in nature (minimum 60% marks required; 1:5 shortlisting ratio from CBT). The final selection panel is drawn up purely in order of marks obtained in the Stage 1 Written CBT among candidates qualifying the Skill Test.

financial_package.note: Technical Assistants and Scientific Assistants in ISRO / Department of Space are appointed under the Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 7 (Entry Basic Pay ₹44,900; ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400). Compensation includes central Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (30% in Class X cities such as Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Ahmedabad), Transport Allowance, and Department of Space special welfare benefits.
